criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Opens under 210 chars, names the institutional role and the claim direction, signals correction without snark; one point off because the asserter's name is withheld until paragraph 1 rather than the hook itself.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Claim is live and consequential for AK delegation vote, Alaska Airlines/GCI labor, and HCR 3 revival; correction names concrete actors and a three-year window; off one for no dollar amount or contract vehicle.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Paragraph 2 is a full, generous steelman consistent with dossier steelman (earlier sweeping-preemption drafts, AFL-CIO credibility, unsettled development/deployment line) before any rebuttal; no snark.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Both rebuttal points rest on primary sources in the dossier: Roll Call June 4 (bill-text carve-out, reverified) and akleg.gov (HCR 3 status, reverified).

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named entities and dates roughly every 1-2 sentences: Scheideman, Council 30, AFA-CWA, Obernolte-Trahan, Roll Call, June 4, HCR 3, May 16 2025, Alaska Airlines, GCI.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim traces to primary ADN op-ed; counter-evidence to Roll Call (credible, direct bill-text quote) and akleg.gov (primary); off one because Roll Call is credible secondary, not the federal docket itself.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, position-taking; 'flips the threat' and 'a floor to build on, not a wall to fear' are corrective without contempt; no influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Five paragraphs of 2-4 sentences, 427 words, 2635 chars; clean mobile/desktop scan.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real, debatable question tied to the corrected frame (fight preemption vs. race to legislate); no softener or CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: A delegation staffer or employer can name a concrete decision: lobby for HCR 3 revival before the three-year window closes; off one for no named contract vehicle.

hard_fail_checks.name: hashtag_count_in_range
hard_fail_checks.detail: 4 hashtags on trailing line, all whitelist, none inline.

hard_fail_checks.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fail_checks.detail: Zero em/en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body.

hard_fail_checks.name: claim_is_attributed
hard_fail_checks.detail: Names LeiLauni Scheideman, President AFA-CWA Council 30, quotes claim verbatim matching selected_claim.asserters[0].

hard_fail_checks.name: steelman_present
hard_fail_checks.detail: Paragraph 2 steelmans fully before paragraph 3 rebuttal, consistent with dossier steelman.
